words.definition_en: an informal, friendly conversation.
words.sentence_en: We had a friendly chat over a cup of coffee.
words.sentence_tw: 我們喝著咖啡，愉快地閒聊。
words.analysis: 非正式、輕鬆無壓力的對話。
words.timing: 描述日常社交、線上通訊或朋友聚會時。

words.definition_en: having much or varied color; full of interest or excitement.
words.definition_tw: 多采多姿的；色彩鮮豔的
words.sentence_en: She led a colorful and adventurous life as a journalist.
words.sentence_tw: 作為一名記者，她過著多采多姿且充滿冒險的生活。
words.analysis: 既指視覺色彩繽紛，也比喻經歷豐富精采。
words.timing: 描繪慶典、藝術作品或豐富的人生經歷時。

words.definition_en: the state of being free from public attention or disturbance.
words.sentence_en: Social media users should pay close attention to their personal privacy.
words.sentence_tw: 社群媒體使用者應該密切注意個人隱私。
words.analysis: 不可數名詞，指個人私密不願受打擾的狀態。
words.timing: 討論網路安全、個人資料保障或生活隱私時。

words.definition_en: reasoning conducted or assessed according to strict principles.
words.sentence_en: There is clear logic behind his decision-making process.
words.sentence_tw: 在他的決策過程背後有著清晰的邏輯。
words.analysis: 不可數名詞，強調思考與推理的條理。
words.timing: 分析推理過程、辯論或程式思維時。

words.definition_en: having or seeming to have no end or limit.
words.sentence_en: The internet provides an endless supply of information.
words.sentence_tw: 網際網路提供了源源不絕的資訊。
words.analysis: 形容無限延續、沒有盡頭的事物。
words.timing: 描述無窮可能性、繁瑣工作或遼闊景致時。

words.definition_en: full of fun and high spirits; lighthearted.
words.sentence_en: The puppy was very playful and chased the ball around.
words.sentence_tw: 這隻小狗非常愛玩，追著球跑來跑去。
words.analysis: 形容性格活潑愛玩，互動輕鬆。
words.timing: 描述寵物互動、兒童舉止或幽默語氣時。

words.definition_en: made, done, or seen on a computer or on the internet.
words.sentence_en: During the pandemic, many students attended virtual classes.
words.sentence_tw: 在疫情期間，許多學生參加了虛擬線上課程。
words.analysis: 指透過電腦或網路模擬產生的情境。
words.timing: 討論線上學習、元宇宙、電玩或遠距會議時。

words.definition_en: move displayed text or graphics on a computer screen.
words.sentence_en: He spent hours scrolling through social media on his phone.
words.sentence_tw: 他花了數小時在手機上滑社群媒體。
words.analysis: 常用於 scroll down / scroll through 瀏覽網頁或社群。
words.timing: 描述使用智慧型手機或瀏覽網頁時。

words.definition_en: be in charge of; succeed in achieving something.
patterns: manage to V（設法做成某事）
words.sentence_en: She learned how to manage her time effectively.
words.sentence_tw: 她學會了如何有效管理自己的時間。
words.analysis: 及物動詞指經營；manage to V 表設法克服困難完成任務。
words.timing: 討論時間管理、企業經營或克服困境時。

words.definition_en: of or prompted by feelings of tenderness, sadness, or nostalgia.
words.definition_tw: 充滿感情的；多愁善感的
words.sentence_en: This old photo album has great sentimental value to me.
words.sentence_tw: 這本舊相簿對我來說具有重大情感價值。
words.analysis: 帶有懷舊感或對舊物/回憶寄予深厚情感。
words.timing: 討論紀念品、老照片、童年回憶或感人劇情時。

words.definition_en: made or produced by human beings rather than occurring naturally.
words.sentence_en: Artificial intelligence is changing the way we live and work.
words.sentence_tw: 人工智慧正在改變我們的生活和工作方式。
words.analysis: 與 natural 相對，指人造材質或科技模擬產物。
words.timing: 討論 AI 科技、人造材質或加工食品時。

words.definition_en: rot or decompose through the action of bacteria.
words.sentence_en: Sugar can cause tooth decay if you don't brush properly.
words.sentence_tw: 如果你沒有好好刷牙，糖分會導致蛀牙（牙齒腐爛）。
words.analysis: 可指有機物腐敗，也可指文明或健康的衰退。
words.timing: 討論口腔衛生、自然分解或歷史文明興衰時。

words.definition_en: give money or goods for a good cause, especially to a charity.
words.sentence_en: Many people donated money to help the earthquake victims.
words.sentence_tw: 許多人捐款幫助地震受害者。
words.analysis: 指無償捐出金錢、物資、血液或器官。
words.timing: 討論慈善公益、捐血賑災或社會福利時。

words.definition_en: the action of adopting a child or animal; accepting an idea.
words.sentence_en: They decided to support pet adoption instead of buying.
words.sentence_tw: 他們決定支持寵物領養，而不是購買。
words.analysis: 指領養兒童/寵物，也可指新制度或技術的採用。
words.timing: 討論流浪動物保護、家庭領養或新制度引進時。

words.definition_en: a set of related web pages under a single domain name.
words.sentence_en: You can find more information on our official website.
words.sentence_tw: 您可以在我們的官方網站上找到更多資訊。
words.analysis: 網際網路上的特定站台。
words.timing: 討論網路資訊、線上購物或網址引導時。

words.definition_en: without being affected by; in spite of.
words.comparison: despite + N/V-ing vs. although + S + V
words.sentence_en: Despite the heavy rain, they enjoyed their outdoor concert.
words.sentence_tw: 儘管下著大雨，他們仍然很享受戶外演唱會。
words.analysis: 介系詞，後面只能接名詞或動名詞，不可接子句。
words.timing: 作文撰寫轉折語氣、克服逆境或對比落差時。

words.definition_en: a soft toy bear.
words.sentence_en: The little child holds a teddy bear while sleeping.
words.sentence_tw: 這孩子睡覺時抱著一隻泰迪熊。
words.analysis: 指填充熊玩具，帶來安全感與陪伴感。
words.timing: 描述童年回憶、陪伴玩具或禮物時。

words.definition_en: a toy made of cloth and filled with soft material.
words.sentence_en: She collects all kinds of soft stuffed toys in her bedroom.
words.sentence_tw: 她在臥室裡收集了各種軟綿綿的填充玩具。
words.analysis: 泛指內部塞滿棉花等軟質填充物的布偶。
words.timing: 描述玩具、禮物或童趣裝飾時。

words.definition_en: healthcare provided remotely via telecommunications technology.
words.sentence_en: Telehealth services became essential during the global pandemic.
words.sentence_tw: 在全球疫情期間，遠距醫療服務變得至關重要。
words.analysis: 指利用視訊通訊技術進行遠距看診與醫療諮詢。
words.timing: 討論智慧醫療、偏鄉醫療資源或數位健康時。

words.definition_en: the quality of being easy to reach, enter, or use.
related_words: accessible (adj.) 可接近的；易獲得的
words.sentence_en: The subway system improves the accessibility of downtown areas.
words.sentence_tw: 捷運系統提高了市中心區域的易達性。
words.analysis: 指設施、資訊或服務是否容易獲取與抵達。
words.timing: 討論無障礙設施、公共運輸或數位資源普及度時。

words.definition_en: concentrate on and become expert in a particular subject.
words.sentence_en: Dr. Lin specializes in heart surgery.
words.sentence_tw: 林醫師專攻心臟手術。
words.analysis: 不及物動詞，核心句型為 specialize in。
words.timing: 討論大學科系、醫師專長、公司核心業務時。

words.definition_en: a device that detects or measures a physical property.
words.sentence_en: The automatic doors use a motion sensor to detect visitors.
words.sentence_tw: 自動門使用動態感測器來偵測訪客。
words.analysis: 感測光線、溫度、運動或重量等物理訊號的裝置。
words.timing: 討論物聯網（IoT）、自動駕駛或智慧家電時。

words.definition_en: spread from one person or organism to another by direct or indirect contact.
words.sentence_en: The flu is highly contagious, so you should wear a mask.
words.sentence_tw: 流感具有高度傳染性，所以你應該戴上口罩。
words.analysis: 指疾病易傳染，也可比喻情緒具感染力。
words.timing: 討論防疫、傳染病流行或歡樂氣氛感染他人時。

words.definition_en: the action or process of formally consulting or discussing.
words.sentence_en: You should book a consultation with a specialist for advice.
words.sentence_tw: 你應該預約專科醫師的諮詢以獲得建議。
words.analysis: 指向專業人士（醫師、律師、顧問）尋求意見商討。
words.timing: 醫療門診、法律諮詢、商業顧問對談時。

words.definition_en: a small or tiny part or amount of something; numerical fraction.
words.sentence_en: Online stores sell products at a fraction of the cost.
words.sentence_tw: 網路商店以實體店極小部分的成本價格販售商品。
words.analysis: 數學上的分數，常比喻極微小的比例或費用。
words.timing: 形容花費極少、時間短暫或微小佔比時。

words.definition_en: causing or able to cause death.
words.sentence_en: The snake carries a deadly poison.
words.sentence_tw: 這條蛇帶有致命毒液。
words.analysis: 形容能致人於死的毒素、疾病、武器或災害。
words.timing: 描述危險疾病、毒物、車禍或自然災害時。

words.definition_en: inexpensive; reasonably priced.
words.sentence_en: The government is trying to build more affordable housing.
words.sentence_tw: 政府正努力興建更多負擔得起的住宅。
words.analysis: 表示價格合理、在能力承受範圍內。
words.timing: 討論消費購物、住宅價格或平價產品時。

words.definition_en: admit (someone) to hospital for treatment.
words.sentence_en: He was hospitalized for three days after the serious car accident.
words.sentence_tw: 在嚴重的車禍發生後，他住院治療了三天。
words.analysis: 常以被動形式 be hospitalized 出現，指安排住院。
words.timing: 描述重大傷病、急診住院或醫療照護時。

words.definition_en: a sudden disabling attack caused by an interruption of blood flow to the brain.
words.sentence_en: Fast medical treatment is vital for patients having a stroke.
words.sentence_tw: 快速的醫療處置對於中風患者來說至關重要。
words.analysis: 指腦血管阻塞或破裂所引發的急症。
words.timing: 討論高齡照護、急救常識或血管疾病時。

words.definition_en: a gelatinous mass formed by red blood cells and platelets.
words.sentence_en: The doctor gave him medication to dissolve the dangerous blood clot.
words.sentence_tw: 醫生給他藥物以溶解危險的血栓。
words.analysis: 血液凝結成的塊狀物，若堵塞血管會引發重症。
words.timing: 描述心血管疾病、手術後併發症或血液循環時。

words.definition_en: an object or feature of a landscape or town easily recognized.
words.sentence_en: Taipei 101 is one of the most famous landmarks in Taiwan.
words.sentence_tw: 台北101是台灣最著名的地標之一。
words.analysis: 具代表性的建築景觀，也可指歷史里程碑。
words.timing: 觀光旅遊、都市介紹或歷史里程碑時。

words.definition_en: a person who is traveling or visiting a place for pleasure.
words.sentence_en: Thousands of tourists visit the ancient castle every year.
words.sentence_tw: 每年有數千名遊客參觀這座古老的城堡。
words.analysis: 前往異地觀光休閒的人。
words.timing: 討論景點導覽、出國旅遊或觀光經濟時。

words.definition_en: the commercial organization and operation of holidays and visits to places of interest.
words.sentence_en: Tourism plays a vital role in the island's local economy.
words.sentence_tw: 觀光業在該島嶼的在地經濟中扮演著關鍵角色。
words.analysis: 不可數名詞，指觀光產業整體。
words.timing: 討論產業發展、觀光政策或地方創生時。

words.definition_en: include (something) as a necessary part or result.
words.sentence_en: The new project will involve team members from different departments.
words.sentence_tw: 這項新專案將包含來自不同部門的團隊成員。
words.analysis: 指專案或活動涵蓋特定內容，被動 be involved in 表參與。
words.timing: 說明任務範疇、團體參與或案件牽涉時。

words.definition_en: a short extract from a movie or television program.
words.sentence_en: She posted a short video clip of her cat on the internet.
words.sentence_tw: 她在網路上貼出了一段她貓咪的短片剪輯。
words.analysis: 片段影片或音訊，短小精悍。
words.timing: 討論影音社群、新聞剪輯或電影預告時。

words.definition_en: an outstanding part of an event; emphasize.
words.definition_tw: 最精彩的部分；亮點 / 強調
words.sentence_en: The fireworks show was the highlight of our trip.
words.sentence_tw: 煙火秀是我們這次旅行中最精彩的亮點。
words.analysis: 指活動中最吸引人的重點，或動詞標示強調。
words.timing: 活動檢討、旅遊回顧或強調重點時。

words.definition_en: a thing that is kept as a reminder of a place or event.
words.sentence_en: She bought a keychain as a souvenir from Paris.
words.sentence_tw: 她買了一個鑰匙圈作為來自巴黎的紀念品。
words.analysis: 購買留存以資紀念的物品。
words.timing: 旅遊伴手禮、活動紀念物時。

phrases.definition_tw: 與（某人或某物）建立聯繫／連結
phrases.sentence_en: Music helps people connect with each other across cultures.
phrases.sentence_tw: 音樂有助於來自不同文化的人們建立互相的連結。
phrases.analysis: 建立情感交流或思想共鳴。

phrases.sentence_en: Children learn social skills when they interact with peers.
phrases.sentence_tw: 孩子們在與同儕互動時學習社交技巧。
phrases.analysis: 指雙向交流或人際互動。

phrases.sentence_en: Many teenagers use social media to share their daily lives.
phrases.sentence_tw: 許多青少年使用社群媒體來分享他們的日常生活。
phrases.analysis: 如 Instagram、Facebook、YouTube 等網路平台。

phrases.sentence_en: They enjoyed a brief social chat before the meeting started.
phrases.sentence_tw: 他們在會議開始前進行了短暫的社交聊天。
phrases.analysis: 輕鬆寒暄的社交性談話。

phrases.sentence_en: Taking a short social break helps workers recharge their minds.
phrases.sentence_tw: 進行短暫的社交喘息有助於上班族補充心靈能量。
phrases.analysis: 自工作或高壓社交中暫時離線休息。

phrases.sentence_en: Her quick thinking saved the child from the sudden accident.
phrases.sentence_tw: 她敏捷的思考反應救了孩子免於突發事故。
phrases.analysis: 臨危不亂、迅速反應的能力。

phrases.sentence_en: Practice is an essential part of learning a language.
phrases.sentence_tw: 練習是學習語言不可或缺的一部分。
phrases.analysis: 表達整體中的某個構成要素。

phrases.sentence_en: The repaired old car got a new lease on life.
phrases.sentence_tw: 修復後的舊車重獲新生。
phrases.analysis: 比喻經過改善後煥發活力。

phrases.sentence_en: Although the exam is tough, I will give it my best shot.
phrases.sentence_tw: 雖然考試很艱難，我還是會全力以赴。
phrases.analysis: 拿出最佳表現奮力一試。

phrases.sentence_en: Don't toss out useful old books; donate them instead.
phrases.sentence_tw: 不要丟棄有用的舊書，把 Ignore 它們捐出去吧。
phrases.analysis: 將無用之物拋棄扔掉。

phrases.sentence_en: Plastic waste often ends up in the ocean.
phrases.sentence_tw: 塑膠垃圾最終常落得流入海洋的下場。
phrases.analysis: 強調歷經過程後的最終結局。

phrases.sentence_en: We walked to school instead of taking the bus.
phrases.sentence_tw: 我們走路去學校，而不是搭公車。
phrases.analysis: 介系詞，後面接名詞或 V-ing。

phrases.sentence_en: Your act of kindness can make a huge difference.
phrases.sentence_tw: 你的善行可以產生巨大的影響。
phrases.analysis: 帶來實質的改變與效益。

phrases.sentence_en: The mountains look majestic from a distance.
phrases.sentence_tw: 群山從遠處看顯得十分雄偉。
phrases.analysis: 保持距離觀看或遠觀。

phrases.sentence_en: Learning English opens up many career opportunities.
phrases.sentence_tw: 學習英文能為職涯展開許多可能性。
phrases.analysis: 開放機會、敞開心扉或開發區域。

phrases.sentence_en: I prefer to talk to my clients in person.
phrases.sentence_tw: 我傾向於當面與我的客戶談話。
phrases.analysis: 與遠距或線上相對，強調本人出席。

phrases.sentence_en: He bought the jacket at a fraction of its original price.
phrases.sentence_tw: 他以原本極小一部分的價格買下了這件夾克。
phrases.analysis: 形容極低的比例或花費。

phrases.sentence_en: We made a trip to Tainan during the long weekend.
phrases.sentence_tw: 我們在連假期間前往台南一遊。
phrases.analysis: 出發前往某地進行短程旅行。

phrases.definition_tw: 隨手買/快速吃點心或飲料
phrases.sentence_en: Let's grab a quick drink after work.
phrases.sentence_tw: 下班後我們去隨手買一杯飲料喝吧。
phrases.analysis: 口語美語，指方便快速購買飲食。

phrases.definition_tw: 帶回家；帶走（如：帶紀念品）
phrases.sentence_en: Visitors can take home unique souvenirs from the market.
phrases.sentence_tw: 遊客可以從市集帶走獨特的紀念品回家。
phrases.analysis: 將旅行禮品或餐點攜回。

phrases.sentence_en: You should carefully think about your future choices.
phrases.sentence_tw: 你應該仔細考慮你未來的選擇。
phrases.analysis: 針對特定議題思考評估。

phrases.sentence_en: Stepping into the old library feels like traveling back in time.
phrases.sentence_tw: 踏入這座老圖書館感覺就像穿越時空。
phrases.analysis: 進入某空間或涉足某領域。

phrases.definition_tw: 快速展開行動；投入行動
phrases.sentence_en: The medical team swung into action as soon as the patient arrived.
phrases.sentence_tw: 病人一抵達，醫療團隊立刻快速展開行動。
phrases.analysis: 毫不拖延，迅速進入高效率狀態。

phrases.sentence_en: His brilliant suggestion saved the day for our project.
phrases.sentence_tw: 他極佳的建議讓我們的專案轉危為安。
phrases.analysis: 在關鍵時刻化解危機。

phrases.definition_tw: 以……最為人熟知 / 出名
phrases.sentence_en: Tainan is best known for its rich history and delicious street food.
phrases.sentence_tw: 台南以其豐富的歷史和美味的小吃最為人熟知。
phrases.analysis: 因特定特徵或特產遠近馳名。

phrases.sentence_en: Many students signed up for the weekend coding workshop.
phrases.sentence_tw: 許多學生報名參加了週末的程式設計工作坊。
phrases.analysis: 登記報名課程或活動。

phrases.sentence_en: She decided to try out for the school basketball team.
phrases.sentence_tw: 她決定參加學校籃球隊的選拔。
phrases.analysis: 爭取球隊、劇組或團體的席次選拔。

phrases.definition_tw: 大好機會；突破性的轉機
phrases.sentence_en: Winning the singing competition was her big break in showbiz.
phrases.sentence_tw: 赢得歌唱比賽是她在演藝圈的大好轉機。
phrases.analysis: 職涯或人生轉折的關鍵重大契機。

phrases.sentence_en: Visiting Tokyo was a dream come true for the young girl.
phrases.sentence_tw: 造訪東京對這位年輕女孩來說是夢想成真。
phrases.analysis: 盼望已久的願望實現。

phrases.sentence_en: Skydiving is on top of his bucket list.
phrases.sentence_tw: 高空跳傘位於他人升願望清單的頂端。
phrases.analysis: 有生之年期望完成的清單。

phrases.sentence_en: We had the time of our lives during the graduation trip.
phrases.sentence_tw: 我們在畢業旅行中度過了人生中最快樂的時光。
phrases.analysis: 形容極度盡興、美好的回憶時光。

phrases.definition_tw: 在其他條件相同的情況下
phrases.sentence_en: All else being equal, voters tend to choose the more experienced candidate.
phrases.sentence_tw: 在其他條件相同的情況下，選民傾向選擇經驗豐富的候選人。
phrases.analysis: 邏輯推論前提條件。

phrases.sentence_en: Don't fall for internet scams that promise quick money.
phrases.sentence_tw: 不要上那些承諾快速賺錢的網路詐騙的當。
phrases.analysis: 輕信謊言或陷阱而上當。

phrases.sentence_en: There is no shortcut to success in learning English.
phrases.sentence_tw: 學習英文走向成功沒有捷徑可走。
phrases.analysis: 尋求快速途徑或投機做法。

phrases.sentence_en: Never give up on your dreams, no matter how tough it gets.
phrases.sentence_tw: 無論變得多艱難，永遠不要放棄你的夢想。
phrases.analysis: 對人或夢想失去信心而放棄。

phrases.sentence_en: Many nations are aiming to achieve net zero carbon emissions by 2050.
phrases.sentence_tw: 許多國家目標在 2050 年前實現碳淨零排放。
phrases.analysis: 溫室氣體排放與抵銷平衡。

phrases.sentence_en: The survey was conducted by an independent third party.
phrases.sentence_tw: 這項調查是由獨立的第三方進行的。
phrases.analysis: 兩造合約外的中立參與者。

phrases.definition_tw: 與……保持一致；符合（法規等）
phrases.sentence_en: Your actions should align with your personal values.
phrases.sentence_tw: 你的行為應該與你的個人價值觀保持一致。
phrases.analysis: 立場、目標或規範相互吻合。
